items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Recordings, rule, angle line, template, fit criteria, pins all in the diff; tolerance, metric, check and plugins untouched.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Fixture data only; the tests assert on missing/invalid shape (4/4/4, tz-aware stamps, invented hosts).

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Recordings use invented .example hosts and authors; no keys or real accounts.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Mockup text is recomputed from data+rule+template by an independent implementation; S05 findRecorded checked on the shipped files.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: seed/recorded/ mirrors the built project's path; tests grouped at the end of the existing file.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer: package files; consumer: package hash, brief_package layout, S05 findRecorded, build copy. Probed: verify_package with new files, validate_layout [], findRecorded on a temp project built from the shipped files.
